title: In the Cross of Christ I Glory
description: In the Cross of Christ I Glory in Tonic Solfa to ALL FOR JESUS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Bowring wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 649 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Cross of Christ”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ALL FOR JESUS; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: In the cross of Christ I glo-ry, Tow-ering o'er the wrecks of time; All the light of sa-cred sto-ry Gath-ers round its head sub-lime.

lines: In the cross of Christ I glory,
Towering o'er the wrecks of time;
All the light of sacred story
When the woes of life o'ertake me,
Never shall the cross forsake me;
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.
When the sun of bliss is beaming
Light and love upon my way,
From the cross the radiance streaming
Adds more lustre to the day.
Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
Peace is there that knows no measure,
Joys that through all time abide.

licence: Public domain: John Bowring died in 1872.
credits: Words by John Bowring (1792–1872), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ALL FOR JESUS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
